about: You'll Get Your Rent When You Fix This Damn Door is a frame of Tobey Maguire as Peter Parker in Spider-Man 2 (2004), standing in a dark hallway, eyes wide and mouth half open mid-shout at his landlord. Across the bottom is his line with two blanks: "You'll get your ___ when you FIX THIS DAMN ___!" The template turns it into a standoff between two people who each refuse to give something until the other does first. You fill one blank with what is being demanded and the other with the broken thing that has to be fixed before you will hand it over.
origin: The line comes from Spider-Man 2 (2004), from Peter's argument with his landlord, Mr. Ditkovich, over unpaid rent. The blanked-out version spread on Reddit and imgflip in 2022.
usage:
The first box fills the first blank: what the other side wants from you ("pr review", "homework", "likes"). The second box fills the second blank: what they have to fix first ("lint", "wifi", "algorithm"). Keep both to one or two words so they fit the gaps in the caption.

It works for any mutual hostage situation: a manager asking for productivity while the laptop is broken, a game studio asking for reviews of a buggy release, fans withholding hype until the team fixes the defense.
